svg.text: MOLECULAR CHEMISORPTION: AMINE CARBAMATE SPECIATION VS DIAMINE-MOF ISOTHERM
Zwitterion Reaction Coordinates, Stoichiometric Limits & Metal-Organic Framework Cooperative Insertion (Bocanegra 2024 / Siegelman 2017)
BASIS: MOLECULAR REACTION DYNAMICS & COOPERATIVE ADSORPTION ISOTHERMS
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: • Step 2 (Proton Transfer): R-NH2+-COO- + R-NH2 <=> R-NHCOO- + R-NH3+
• STOICHIOMETRIC LOADING LIMIT: α = 0.50 mol CO2 / mol amine
• Absorption Enthalpy: ΔH_abs = -84.5 kJ/mol CO2 (Strong chemical bond)
• Thermal Regeneration: Requires high T (120 °C) & steam duty to break carbamate
• Industrial Solvent: 30 wt% MEA, CANSOLV DC-103, Piperazine
• Base-Catalyzed Hydration: CO2 + R1R2R3N + H2O <=> HCO3- + R1R2R3NH+
• Hindered Carbamate Hydrolysis: R-NHCOO- + H2O <=> R-NH3+ + HCO3-
• STOICHIOMETRIC LOADING LIMIT: α = 1.00 mol CO2 / mol amine (2x MEA!)
• Absorption Enthalpy: ΔH_abs = -60 to -65 kJ/mol CO2 (Moderate bond)
• Thermal Regeneration: Significantly lower regeneration energy (-25% steam)
THERMODYNAMIC REACTION COORDINATE (FREE ENERGY G vs PROGRESS)
HEXAGONAL 1D PORE CHANNEL & AMMONIUM CARBAMATE CHAINS
• Cooperative Mechanism: CO2 inserts between Mg2+ and amine,
inducing cooperative proton relay along channel c-axis
• Step-shaped adsorption threshold: P_step tunable by diamine alkyl chain
• Low Regeneration Penalty: Full desorption with ΔT < 50 °C (Huge saving!)
STEP-SHAPED ADSORPTION ISOTHERM: MOF VS TRADITIONAL LANGMUIR
AUDIT METRICS: Carbamate Limit: 0.5 mol/mol | Bicarbonate: 1.0 mol/mol | MOF Step: 420 ppmv
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: Bocanegra (2024); Siegelman et al. (2017) JACS
